title: Assembly of God, Main Street 1987
description: The Assembly of God, affiliated with the Pentecostal denomination, was dedicated on July 6, 1956. Eight charter members founded the church and built it on land purchased from G. R. Miller on Main Street. The church was enlarged and its interior improved in 1966. Pastors John and Norma Write served the congregation. (From K. Hatfield’s History of Churches)
